fixes.description: git log stderr hang: stderr pipe buffer could fill and cause deadlock during wait()
fixes.fix: Spawn a dedicated thread to drain stderr concurrently with stdout reading, then join after wait()

fixes.description: max_sim initialized to 0.0, negative cosine similarities rounded to 0.0
fixes.fix: Changed max_sim initialization from 0.0 to f32::NEG_INFINITY

fixes.description: find_by_path() Err silently swallowed via unwrap_or_default()
fixes.fix: Replaced unwrap_or_default() with explicit match that emits eprintln! warning on Err

fixes.description: Path output written without sanitization, control character injection risk
fixes.fix: Added sanitize_path() helper that strips control characters (except tab) and applied to all path output functions

fixes.description: Unknown relation string from DB output to stderr without sanitization
fixes.fix: Replace control characters with U+FFFD before outputting to stderr

fixes.description: Regex compiled at runtime with expect(), panic risk on pattern change
fixes.fix: Moved regex to static LazyLock<Regex> (ISSUE_RE) for compile-time-like initialization
